title: Stock ML Lab — Research Analytics
findings: Discovery: PETR4.SA 20d Logistic reached AUC 0.628 and +2.24% Log Loss improvement versus the prior.
Discovery: PETR4.SA 20d Ridge reached +4.47% RMSE improvement versus Zero Return.
Locked confirmation: 20d Logistic won on 1/9 assets; median improvement -0.34%.
Locked confirmation: 20d Ridge won on 4/9 assets; median improvement -0.11%.
Confirmatory inference: 0 locked asset-level result(s) survived primary HAC/FDR significance at 5%.
Bootstrap robustness: 0 M8.1 asset/candidate result(s) had a fully positive 95% primary-improvement interval.
M13: global scope won 10/10 classification assets and 9/10 regression assets at h=5; pooled improvements were +0.82% Log Loss and +0.89% RMSE.
M13 robustness checks are explicitly post hoc; they motivate but do not replace independent confirmation.
M14 confirmed Global Ridge over Local Ridge at h=5: +1.72% OOS RMSE improvement, HAC/FDR q=0.0001, bootstrap 95% CI [+0.91%, +2.56%], and 9/10 asset wins.
M14 did not confirm Global Logistic over Local Logistic: +0.41% Log Loss improvement, q=0.1577, bootstrap 95% CI [-0.39%, +1.22%].
The confirmed result concerns forecasting loss and training scope; it is not evidence of an economically tradable strategy.
